name: Something in the Woods
objective: Search Frostpine Route for the source of the aggression — and deal with whoever is out there.
intro: Wild Pokémon scatter as you walk the frozen route. Someone steps out from between the pines, dressed in dark crimson.
dialogue: Krampus Recruit (defeated): "This isn't over. The Boss will hear about you."
lore_discovery: The insignia the recruit drops was apparently being used to mark certain Pokémon.
